protectedUsage: any additional session or model usage not explicitly authorised by the user

profiles.bindingRule: Use only an actually available, explicitly user-approved Codex model. GPT-6.1 Sol is a conditional recommendation, not a verified account capability. If absent, the user must choose an available Sol version or another approved model; never fall back to API authentication.

requires: a minimised reproducer or a precise unresolved contract conflict
two distinct hypothesis-driven attempts where repair is possible
specific failed invariant and concrete artefact/log path
actual host support for the proposed setting
explicit user approval for the change and its usage
nonTriggers: network outage or unsupported private API
escalationPolicy.ifUnsupported: Keep an explicitly approved supported setting, decompose the task and record the difference; do not silently upgrade the model or claim xhigh execution.
